story.template.moon.line: A child helps a quiet garden shine by sharing small acts of kindness.
story.template.moon.0.text: At sunset, {name} found a silver seed beside the garden gate. It felt warm in one small hand.
story.template.moon.0.scene: A child holding a silver seed beside a garden gate at sunset.
story.template.moon.1.text: A tiny moth fluttered down. “That is a moonflower seed,” it said. “Shall we find it a home?”
story.template.moon.1.scene: A small moth beside the silver seed in a warm evening garden.
story.template.moon.2.text: {name} chose a patch of soft earth. Together they made a little bed beside a sleepy stone.
story.template.moon.2.scene: A child planting a seed beside a smooth stone.
story.template.moon.3.text: The watering can was almost empty. {name} gave the seed the last few drops and whispered, “Welcome.”
story.template.moon.3.scene: A child watering a newly planted seed in gentle evening light.
story.template.moon.4.text: A beetle arrived with a leaf for shade. {name} held it steady while the beetle tucked it into the earth.
story.template.moon.4.scene: A beetle helping a child place a leaf shelter over a seed.
story.template.moon.5.text: They waited. Nothing happened. Then {name} noticed a green curl, smaller than a little finger.
story.template.moon.5.scene: A tiny green sprout curling out of the earth.
story.template.moon.6.text: A breeze rattled the gate. {name} and the moth gathered fallen twigs to make a gentle fence.
story.template.moon.6.scene: A child and moth arranging small twigs around a sprout.
story.template.moon.7.text: The sprout grew one soft leaf. The leaf caught a drop of water and held it like a shining bead.
story.template.moon.7.scene: A soft green leaf holding a bright drop of water.
story.template.moon.8.text: Above the trees, the moon appeared. The small plant lifted its head toward the light.
story.template.moon.8.scene: A young moonflower reaching toward a moon above the trees.
story.template.moon.9.text: A pale flower opened. Its petals glowed softly, just enough to show the beetle the way home.
story.template.moon.9.scene: A pale glowing flower lighting a beetle’s garden path.
story.template.moon.10.text: “Everyone brought something,” said {name}. A little water, a leaf, a fence, and time to wait.
story.template.moon.10.scene: A child, moth and beetle resting beside a glowing flower.
story.template.moon.11.text: Before bed, {name} looked back at the garden. Small kindnesses had made a place for something wonderful to grow.
story.template.moon.11.scene: A peaceful moonlit garden with one softly glowing flower.
story.template.teddy.line: A missing teddy finds the way home with patient looking and friendly help.
story.template.teddy.0.text: When the picnic blanket was folded, {name} noticed an empty place. Teddy was not in the basket.
story.template.teddy.0.scene: A child looking into a picnic basket beside a folded blanket.
story.template.teddy.1.text: {name} took a slow breath. “We can look together,” said a familiar voice. They started where they had eaten.
story.template.teddy.1.scene: A child and a trusted grown-up looking around a picnic spot.
story.template.teddy.2.text: Under the bench lay a yellow leaf. It was not Teddy, but it pointed toward the little path.
story.template.teddy.2.scene: A yellow leaf beneath a park bench.
story.template.teddy.3.text: They followed the path to the fountain. A sparrow hopped near a soft ribbon caught on a twig.
story.template.teddy.3.scene: A sparrow near a ribbon on a twig beside a small fountain.
story.template.teddy.4.text: {name} remembered tying that ribbon around Teddy’s neck. “We came this way!”
story.template.teddy.4.scene: A child gently holding a ribbon beside a park path.
story.template.teddy.5.text: At the flower bed, they stopped to listen. The leaves rustled. A squirrel peeked out and hurried up a tree.
story.template.teddy.5.scene: A squirrel peeking from flowers in a friendly park.
story.template.teddy.6.text: The tree stood beside the place where they had read a book. {name} looked around the big roots.
story.template.teddy.6.scene: A child looking beside the wide roots of a park tree.
story.template.teddy.7.text: There was a soft brown ear behind a root. Then another ear, and a small stitched smile.
story.template.teddy.7.scene: A teddy bear peeking from behind a large tree root.
story.template.teddy.8.text: “There you are!” {name} lifted Teddy with both hands. A leaf had become a little hat.
story.template.teddy.8.scene: A child lifting a teddy bear with a leaf on its head.
story.template.teddy.9.text: They brushed away the grass and tied the ribbon again. Teddy was ready for the journey back.
story.template.teddy.9.scene: A child carefully tying a ribbon around a teddy bear.
story.template.teddy.10.text: On the way home, {name} kept Teddy close. Looking slowly had helped them notice the small clues.
story.template.teddy.10.scene: A child carrying a teddy on a peaceful walk home.
story.template.teddy.11.text: That night, Teddy had a place beside the pillow. “Tomorrow,” whispered {name}, “we will have another adventure together.”
story.template.teddy.11.scene: A teddy bear resting beside a pillow in a calm bedroom.
story.template.ocean.line: A shell opens an imaginary ocean where a small helper makes a big difference.
story.template.ocean.0.text: {name} held a shell to one ear. Inside its soft whoosh was a tiny voice: “The ocean parade needs a helper!”
story.template.ocean.0.scene: A child listening to a shell beside the sea.
story.template.ocean.1.text: {name} closed both eyes and imagined a little boat. It floated gently into a sea as blue as morning.
story.template.ocean.1.scene: A small imagined boat on a peaceful morning sea.
story.template.ocean.2.text: A crab waved from a rock. Its parade flag had fallen into a shallow pool.
story.template.ocean.2.scene: A friendly crab waving beside a small tide pool.
story.template.ocean.3.text: {name} used a long reed to lift the flag. The crab gave a happy sideways dance.
story.template.ocean.3.scene: A child in a little boat helping a crab lift a flag with a reed.
story.template.ocean.4.text: Farther along, a turtle carried ribbons. One ribbon was tangled around a floating twig.
story.template.ocean.4.scene: A turtle beside ribbons and a floating twig.
story.template.ocean.5.text: “Slowly,” said {name}. They loosened one loop, then another, until the ribbon drifted free.
story.template.ocean.5.scene: A child and turtle carefully freeing a ribbon from a twig.
story.template.ocean.6.text: At the coral arch, a tiny fish was hiding. “I am too small for a parade,” it whispered.
story.template.ocean.6.scene: A tiny fish hiding near a colorful coral arch.
story.template.ocean.7.text: {name} pointed to a little bell. “You could lead us with that.” The fish rang one bright note.
story.template.ocean.7.scene: A tiny fish ringing a little bell beneath a coral arch.
story.template.ocean.8.text: The crab raised its flag. The turtle waved the ribbons. The small fish led the way with a gentle ring.
story.template.ocean.8.scene: A cheerful ocean parade with a crab, turtle and tiny fish.
story.template.ocean.9.text: {name} sailed beside them. Nobody needed to be the biggest to help the parade move forward.
story.template.ocean.9.scene: A child in a small boat alongside a gentle ocean parade.
story.template.ocean.10.text: A familiar whoosh filled the air. The boat became a thought, and the thought became the shell in one small hand.
story.template.ocean.10.scene: A shell in a child’s hand beside a quiet beach.
story.template.ocean.11.text: {name} placed the shell safely on a shelf. Tomorrow, there would be more small ways to help.
story.template.ocean.11.scene: A treasured shell on a shelf in a peaceful home.
